newsitem.title: USA: Brightpoint buys balance of 3 units.
newsitem.headline: Brightpoint buys balance of 3 units.

text.p: Brightpoint Inc said Tuesday it acquired the balance of three of its subsidiaries, Brightpoint China Ltd, Brightpoint (UK) Ltd and Brightpoint Australia Pty Ltd.

The 20 percent interests acquired were owned by members of management of each of the respective subsidiaries, Brightpoint said. The ownership interests were acquired using cash and stock, resulting in approximately 232,000 new Brightpoint shares outstanding.

"These acquisitions are a key element in our globalization strategy," T. Scott Housefield, president of Brightpoint International Ltd, said in a statement. "Brightpoint now has full ownership of these important subsidiaries and we have created more Brightpoint stockholdings among the members of management."
Brightpoint Inc distributes wireless communication equipment and related products globally.
